fn summa(numeri: Vec<i64>) -> i64 {
    let mut total: i64 = 0;
    for i0 in &(numeri) {
        let n = i0.clone();
        total = faber::exact::store::<i64>(faber::exact::add(total as i128, n as i128), "assignment to `total`");
    }
    total
}

fn main() {
    let valores: Vec<i64> = vec![1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
    println!("{}", summa(valores.clone()));
}
